items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: That was before Joe Oliver and them had gone up there.

ctx.x: pumping more information about your father, but it's a wonderful opportunity for us to hear about him from the best possible source. Anything else about the bands he played with? Anything about the Pierron band in particular, the trip to New York? Did you remember? Oh yes, I can remember. When he first,

that I can recall that he remember, when he first left New Orleans in 1917, he left with Manuel Perez's band and they went to Chicago. I think it was at, I think Mike Fritz was the proprietor's name that they worked up there for. That was before Joe Oliver and them had gone up there. That was in 1917. And then that man was Perez, Lorenzo Teo, my father, Eddie Atkins, and Frankie Haney was playing piano. Well, he stayed there for about nine months and then he came and made a visit home on a vacation for two weeks…
Did he ever say how the band was received up there? Write letters back or anything?
